measurement: R3 COMPLETE (理 — 600 independent problems no head had seen, one head (seed-21 L-BFGS), two disjoint 300-problem sets.
the_reading: the same head, never trained on either set, produces +14.0 and +13.3 points with almost identical intervals and p < 3e-06 on both. 600 problems, zero shared signatures with the head's training set or with each other.

THREE_INDEPENDENT_BASES.reading: three 300-problem draws from one grammar landing within 2.0 points and 0.23 actions. The base rate is a property of the generator. This is what v1 and v2 could never have shown, because they had eleven and twelve distinct problems.

what_R3_settles: the capability result is not a seed artefact, not a same-run artefact, and not a transfer-direction artefact. Four n=300 measurements now: +11.3, +14.0, +13.3 across disjoint sets and both directions, all p < 1e-4.
what_R3_does_NOT_settle: the cost. Every action figure here is the PRE-REGISTERED metric, which does not count the controller's own inference. In tokens G costs 34% more (R2). R2b tests whether a batched scorer clears the 502-token bar fixed at r2b_prereg.json.
bounds: One model (7B), one layer (18), one head, one grammar. R4 is the second model.
The seed-21 set itself is excluded from this reading: the head was fit on it.
Paired bootstrap, 10,000 resamples, exact McNemar; six pairs across the whole package with no multiplicity adjustment, and the four n=300 pairs survive any reasonable one.
